2610.09644.title: Automatically Building and Updating a Knowledge Graph of MLIP Models
2610.09644.paper_summary: Complementing the many efforts in providing semantic representations of concepts, notions, and entities in materials science, we report and illustrate a process by which we can automatically build a knowledge graph of the fast evolving field of machine learning applied to the prediction of material properties, focusing on MLIP (Machine Learning Interatomic Potential). This LLM-based process relies on multiple steps, from information extraction in documents and articles to a validation loop using SHACL constraints to detect and correct errors. It is carried out on a model-by-model basis, focusing on the consistency of representation, therefore enabling an iterative construction where the addition of new models is facilitated. We illustrate the process by showing a few interesting aspects that can be queried from a knowledge graph built from the models listed in the Matbench Discovery leaderboard.
2610.09644.paper_summary_zh: 補充在材料科學中提供概念、觀念和實體的語義表示的眾多努力，我們報告並說明了一個過程，通過這個過程我們可以自動構建一個快速發展的機器學習領域的知識圖譜，該領域應用於材料性質的預測，重點是MLIP（機器學習原子間勢）。這個基於LLM的過程依賴於多個步驟，從文檔和文章中的信息提取到使用SHACL約束進行的驗證循環，以檢測和修正錯誤。這是在模型逐個基礎上進行的，重點是表示的一致性，因此使得新模型的添加變得更加方便，從而實現了迭代構建。我們通過展示一些可以從根據Matbench Discovery排行榜中列出的模型構建的知識圖譜中查詢的有趣方面來說明這一過程。
